title: The estimator of the seven hand-picked LCFs, as trained weights
description: A net1 that estimates expliCCit's seven hand-picked LCFs as distributions over bins. compact uses it three ways: its input scaler scales the measurements every controller reads, the fixed rule on it (a window of 2^0.25 times its believed bandwidth-delay product) is the reference each closed-loop evaluation is paired with and the first teacher of a new controller, and it is the estimator of the hand-picked baseline. Copied byte for byte from the project compact was forked from, so that compact's experiments read it from compact's own releases (source: release exp-net1v6-149 of Radonux/palaestra, file net1-v6-s0/net1.pt). estimator/SOURCE_PARTS lists the source's parts. The collect step loads the file with compact's code and writes its LCFs, size and SHA-256 to summary.md.
run: mkdir -p "$OUT/estimator" /tmp/src && curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors https://api.github.com/repos/Radonux/palaestra/releases/tags/exp-net1v6-149 > /tmp/source.json && jq -r '[.assets[] | select(.name | contains(".tar.zst.part-"))] | sort_by(.name) | .[] | "\(.name) \(.size) \(.browser_download_url)"' /tmp/source.json > "$OUT/estimator/SOURCE_PARTS" && test -s "$OUT/estimator/SOURCE_PARTS" && cut -d' ' -f3 "$OUT/estimator/SOURCE_PARTS" | while read -r u; do curl -fsSL --retry 5 "$u"; done | zstd -dcq | tar -x -C /tmp/src --wildcards '*net1-v6-s0/net1.pt' && F=$(find /tmp/src -path '*net1-v6-s0/net1.pt' | head -1) && test -s "$F" && cp "$F" "$OUT/estimator/net1.pt"
collect: uv run python -c "import sys; from pathlib import Path; from expliccit_env.train import fit; n, s = fit.load_net1(Path(sys.argv[1])); print('LCFs:', ', '.join(n.lcfs)); print(); print('Measurements read:', fit.raw_width(n))" "$OUT/estimator/net1.pt" > "$OUT/summary.md" && { echo; echo '| file | bytes | sha256 |'; echo '|---|---|---|'; echo "| estimator/net1.pt | $(stat -c %s "$OUT/estimator/net1.pt") | $(sha256sum "$OUT/estimator/net1.pt" | cut -d' ' -f1) |"; } >> "$OUT/summary.md"
